title: Start here: what rx2cpp is and the rules every change keeps
summary: rx2cpp compiles ooRexx 5.3 programs, routines and classes into C++17 and builds them as native ooRexx libraries (.so) that the interpreter loads like any other package. The interpreter is the oracle: compiled output must be byte-identical to interpreted output, including error messages, tracebacks where supported, and the order of side effects. Source: github.com/animatedads/oorexx, folder oorexx2cpp. Version file 0.30.18; continuity notes are HANDOFF_2026-10-13.md (newest) and HANDOFF_2026-10-12.md. Baseline of this sphere: main at 462b445: d43c058, the merge of wip-2026-10-13 at 59d2019 after a full regression (138 scripts) and the self-build passed and its pbench2 merge gate (38.0 s against 117.5 s interpreted), then the handoff records for that code (archive: git archive --format=zip 462b445 oorexx2cpp).
invariants: Byte-identical to the ooRexx 5.3 interpreter. A difference is a bug in rx2cpp unless it is listed in rx2cpp.known-differences.
Port the interpreter's own algorithm (NumberString::addSub, RexxInternalObject::requestString, ...) step for step. Never special-case a test, never approximate.
A native fast path checks its case at run time and otherwise does exactly what the interpreter would; native does not mean no interpreter.
Every fix comes with a test that compares compiled against interpreted output.
Work happens on a wip branch; main is updated only after the full regression and the self-build fixed point pass, and the merged commit is benchmarked (pbench2).
Every update credits: architecture Tom Dyer; coding ChatGPT / Claude (whoever coded it); the writer by model name. A model signs its own work as itself.
Before writing any interpreter bug ticket, check ooRexx trunk (GitHub mirror ooRexx/oorexx): several were already fixed upstream.
procedure: Read HANDOFF_2026-10-13.md top to bottom before changing anything.
Set up ooRexx 5.3 with headers, g++ 13 or clang++, and the Boost headers (rx2cpp.build-and-run).
Reproduce the problem as a small .rex fixture; run it interpreted to get the oracle output.
Fix by porting the interpreter's algorithm; add the fixture to a native/test_*.sh script.
Run the affected test scripts, then the full regression and build_self.sh before merging to main.

provenance.claim: Oracle is the ooRexx 5.3 interpreter; identical means byte-identical; credits.
